metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the one bough, the gate, the tables line, Navarre, and the hush.

yesterday: One bough over the door. No ribbon. No second.
The arch had hawthorn and ribbons. The Rose's bill was Long Meg, title only. A garland went over the mud held high.
Kemp mended a child's dance and was asked again, and he did it again.
On the tables: God's is the quarrel. An old woman asks an old man for revenge and gets patience. You will play the old man.
You were Navarre at two. The hush still came. The licensed book stayed with Garnish through the comedy.
